graph.name: Engie Digital Smart O&M Architecture
graph.categories: IoT, Streaming Data, Serverless Compute, Data Lake
graph.notes: Engie Digital's Smart O&M platform ingests 15M daily IoT messages via Kinesis into an S3 Data Lake while microservices on ECS process messages in real time. Backend compute scales using EC2 Auto Scaling and EC2 Spot Fleets, saving up to 90% compared to On-Demand pricing. API Gateway exposes the data to front-end dashboards and web apps.

edges.notes: Kinesis writes incoming IoT stream data directly to S3 Data Lake.
